osm_report.threat_description:
GlassWorm loader (invisible Unicode payload, Solana dead-drop C2). Payload in randomrepo.js, malicious.js.
Outbound: documented for this malware family (randomrepo.js:12).
The same dropper is planted in 2 directories.
Found by GitHub code search for a confirmed malware signature: codePointAt 0xFE00 0xE0100 eval; codePointAt 0xFE00 0xE0100 Function.
Confirmed by static analysis; the code was read, never executed.
osm_report.payload_description:
Malicious payload found in: randomrepo.js, malicious.js
- Outbound: documented for this malware family (randomrepo.js:12).
- randomrepo.js:12: long run of invisible Unicode variation selectors: an encoded payload that renders as an empty string (+1 more)
- randomrepo.js:12: GlassWorm/ForceMemo fingerprint (variation-selector decoder, Solana dead-drop wallet, ForceMemo marker or C2 address) (+1 more)
